source: 795 “Old Friend”
target: 795 “Amicus Vetus”

source: The leader of the enforcers was around forty, clean-shaven, with dark brown eyes.
target: Dux coercitorum circiter quadraginta annos natus erat, glaber, ac oculis fusco‐castaneis.

source: He responded to Lumian’s question without any expression, “There’s no such rule.”
target: Ad quaestionem Luminiani sine ulla vultu respondit: “Nulla talis regula est.”

source: He meant there was no rule stating that all items on a thief’s body should go to the victim.
target: Intendebat nullam esse regulam quae praescriberet omnia in corpore furtoris reperta victimae tradenda esse.

source: Lumian smiled and asked, “But there’s also no law specifically prohibiting it, right?”
target: Lumian subridens rogavit: “Sed etiam lex nulla est quae id specialiter prohibeat, nonne?”

source: “Right.” The leader of the enforcers nodded slowly.
target: “Ita est.” Dux coercitorum lente annuit.

source: Lumian’s smile broadened. “Coming to Morora means cutting all ties with the past, right?”
target: Risus Luminiani latius factus est. “Ad Mororam veniendi significat omnia vincula cum praeterito rumpere, nonne?”

source: This was inferred from what the clergyman Heraberg had said in the cathedral.
target: Hoc ex illis, quae clericus Heraberg in cathedrali dixerat, concludebatur.

source: “Yes.” The enforcer did not deny it.
target: “Ita.” Coercitor id non negavit.

source: Lumian probed further, “And this thief doesn’t have any other heirs in Morora, does he?”
target: Lumian ulterius quaesivit: “Et hic fur in Morora alias haeredes non habet, numquid?”

source: Before being sent to Morora, serious criminals were sterilized.
target: Antequam in Mororam mittebantur, scelesti graves sterilizati erant.

source: Unless they were part of a criminal family or found a partner with similar criminal interests here, no one in Morora had legal heirs.
target: Nisi fuerint pars familiae sceleratae aut socium cum similibus criminibus inclinatus hic invenierit, nemo in Morora haeredes legitimos habebat.

source: The enforcer didn’t answer Lumian immediately.
target: Coercitor non statim Luminiano respondit.

source: He pulled a thick book from under his black robe and started searching for the relevant records.
target: Sub veste nigra sua, librum crassum extraxit et documenta pertinens quaerere coepit.

source: “Do you know this thief’s name?” Lumian asked thoughtfully.
target: Lumian quaesivit cogitans: “Scisne nomen huius furtoris?”

source: The enforcer nodded. “His name is Worms.”
target: Coercitor annuit: “Nomen eius est Worms.”

source: Soon, the records were found.
target: Mox acta reperta sunt.

source: The enforcer read in a flat voice, “His parents and siblings are not in Morora, and he hasn’t married here, at least not officially registered.”
target: Coercitor voce aequa legit: “Parentes eius et fratres non sunt in Morora, nec hic nupta est, saltem non officialiter registrata.”

source: “So, according to the laws from where I come from, a thief’s possessions go to the person who caught them if there are no other heirs or claimants,” Lumian began to explain, “Just like in a legal duel, the victor can take the spoils.”
target: “Ergo, secundum leges ex loco meo, possessiones furtoris adsunt illo qui ea apprehendit, si ceteri haeredes aut vindicatores absunt,” inchoavit Lumian explanare, “sicut in certamine legali, victor praeda capere potest.”

source: The enforcer stared at Lumian for a few seconds before saying, “Okay.”
target: Coercitor paulisper Luminian aspexit antequam dixit: “Bene.”

source: He and his team stood patiently as Worms’s Beyonder characteristics manifested, merging with one of his fingers, which then broke off, turning semi‐transparent black.
target: Ipse et turma eius patienter steterunt, dum proprietates Beyonder Worms apparuerunt, confluentes cum uno de digitis eius, qui deinde disjectus, semitransparens atque nigerrimus factus est.

source: Lumian put away the Beyonder characteristics but didn’t leave immediately.
target: Lumian proprietates Beyonder recondidit, sed non statim discessit.

source: Instead, he stayed, watching as the enforcers dragged away the body and cleaned the blood and scorch marks from the alley.
target: Sed potius manet, observans dum coercitores corpus trahebant et sanguinem atque signa comburitionis ex via angusta delebant.

source: The clouds above thickened, and lightning and thunder grew more frequent.
target: Nubes caeli densatae sunt, et fulgura ac tonitrua frequentiora facta sunt.

source: Finally, the alley was clean and quiet, with only Lumian remaining.
target: Denique via angusta pura et quieta erat, et solus Lumian remanebat.

source: Lumian nodded thoughtfully, murmuring to himself, The enforcers seem to remember the appearance and names of every Morora resident…
target: Lumian cogitans annuit, sibi submurmurans: “Videtur coercitores formam et nomina omnium incolarum Mororae meminisse…”

source: After becoming enforcers, they are still human but not quite human anymore…
target: Postquam coercitores facti sunt, adhuc sunt homines, sed non iam prorsus homines.

source: He felt that the so‐called enforcers, who were actually experimental personnel, acted like puppets following set procedures, lacking self‐awareness and deep thinking.
target: Sensit dictos coercitores, qui revera experimentales operarii erant, quasi pupae regulas sequentes agere, carentes conscientia sui atque cogitatione profunda.

source: He had deliberately asked if Worms’s belongings were his, not out of greed for the Beyonder characteristics, although that played a small part, as Beyonder characteristics were valuable.
target: Diligenter quaesierat utrum possessiones Worms eius essent, non ex cupiditate proprietatum Beyonder, quamvis parva pars id efficaciter moveret, nam proprietates Beyonder pretiosae erant.

source: He had long figured that Worms wasn’t a Sequence 7 Marauder, as a Sequence 7 called Cryptologist would have deciphered some of the secrets of the items in the Traveler’s Bag and understood their dangers, not dying just after examining three items.
target: Diu arbitratus erat Worms non esse Marauder Sequenciae VII, quoniam Cryptologus, qui Sequenciae VII vocatur, nonnulla arcana rerum in Sacculo Viatoris persolveret et earum pericula cognovisset, non moriturus esse modo tribus obiectis examinatis.

source: Lumian even doubted Worms had reached Sequence 8 Swindler, because the thief didn’t seem smart enough.
target: Lumian etiam dubitavit Worms ad Sequenciam VIII Swindler pervenisse, quia fur non satis ingeniosus apparuit.

source: Lumian’s questions to the enforcers were not to showcase his talent in being a negotiator or exploit loopholes but to test the enforcers’ state.
target: Quaestiones Luminiani ad coercitores non erant ut ingenium suum negotiatori ostenderet nec lacunas legales expleret, sed ut statum coercitorum examinarent.

source: And he had his answer.
target: Et responsum suum obtinuit.

source: He felt that after becoming enforcers, these serious criminals became like the wax figures in the Sauron family’s Red Swan Castle or a combination of the Iron and Blood Cross Order Supervisor Olson, but without the violent madness, instead exhibiting a gentle indifference.
target: Sensit postquam coercitores facti essent, hi scelesti graves vel ut figuras ceratas in Castris Rubri Cygnorum familiae Sauron, vel ut compositio inter Ordinem Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis sub vigilantia Olson, sed sine furori violento, sed cum leni indifferentia se gerere.

source: Is this the combined effect of the 0-01 corruption and Morora’s sealing influence?
target: Num hoc compositum est effectus corruptionis 0-01 atque influentiae sigillantis Mororae?

source: Lumian was unsure if he would retain his self‐awareness if he joined the enforcers, or end up just following Morora’s rules, becoming a puppet of the City of Exiles or 0-01.
target: Lumian non certo sciebat utrum, si coercitoribus iungeret, sui conscientiam retinere posset, aut tantum leges Mororae sequi, quasi marioneta Urbis Exulorum aut 0-01 fieret.

source: This made him waver in his original plan to approach 0-01 as an enforcer.
target: Hoc eum in consilio suo primo ad 0-01 ut coercitor accederet vacillare fecit.

source: He laughed softly, asking in a low voice, “Termiboros, do you want to be Morora’s puppet?”
target: Leniter risit, voce humili rogans: “Termiboros, velisne marioneta Mororae esse?”

source: Termiboros ignored him.
target: Termiboros eum ignoravit.

source: Whoosh!
target: Whoosh!

source: The downpour finally arrived, shrouding Morora in a mist of rain and a doomsday-like gloom.
target: Denique imber pervenit, Mororam in nebulam pluvialis et fatalis obscuritate involvens.

source: Lumian followed the shelter of the huge buildings, avoiding the rain as he headed to the place where the strongest feedback from the Abscessed Hand’s missing parts came from.
target: Lumian sub tegmine ingentium aedificiorum se contulit, imbrem vitans, dum ad locum properabat unde validissima responsio ex partibus Manūs Abscessae proveniebat.

source: When he reached his destination, his clothes were half-soaked by the wind and rain, and the water on the street was nearly up to the steps.
target: Cum ad destinatum pervenisset, vestimenta eius dimidio venti et pluviae madida erant, et aqua in via fere usque ad gradus perveniebat.

source: Lumian glanced to the side, seeing a sign by the door depicting a knife, fork, and wine glass, with the words in Lenburg: “Carnivore”
target: Lumian ad latus intuerebat, videns signum iuxta ostium, quod culter, furca, atque poculum vini repraesentabat, cum verbis in Lenburg: “Carnivore”.

source: A bar serving food? Carnivore… Lumian pondered the bar’s name, suddenly having a strange guess, The feedback indicated that parts of Hand Bro’s body are scattered across Morora, but originally there were only two pieces…
target: Taberna cibum praebens? Carnivore… Lumian de nomine tabernae meditatus est, subito insolitum coniecturam fecit: responsum indicabat partes corporis Hand Bro per Mororam dispersas esse, initio vero tantum duo fragmenta exstare.

source: The demon with the goat face in the Underworld cut and ate Hand Bro’s rotten flesh daily, and it regenerated…
target: Daemon capite caprino in Inferis cotidie secabat et edebat carnem putridam Hand Bro, quae deinde regenerabatur…

source: This bar is called “Carnivore”…
target: Haec taberna “Carnivore” nuncupatur…

source: Could it be that one piece of Hand Bro’s body was obtained by the bar’s owner, saving them the cost of buying meat and using it as a substitute?
target: Numquid fieri potest ut unum ex partibus corporis Hand Bro a domino tabernae adeptum sit, ei impensam emendi carnem servans et tamquam substitutionem adhibitum?

source: Other bar owners in different cities might not do this, but in Morora, they likely would, since they were exiled here for serious crimes.
target: Alii domini tabernarum in diversis urbibus fortasse hoc non facerent, sed in Morora verisimiliter fecerunt, cum hic ex gravibus delinquentiis exulati essent.

source: The bar owner might even be a perverted butcher who killed people and sold their meat…
target: Dominus tabernae etiam fortasse macellarius pervertus esset, qui homines occidit et carnem eorum vendidit…

source: If that’s true, things will be troublesome. Who knows how many people have eaten and integrated Hand Bro’s rotten flesh, and what impact that might have…
target: Si hoc verum est, res difficiles erunt. Quis sciat quot homines carnem putridam Hand Bro comederint et incorporaverint, atque quo modo id afficiat…

source: Can I merge the remaining parts once I find the original two pieces?
target: Possumne reliquas partes iungere, cum duo originaria repperer?

source: Lumian muttered silently for a while, then ran through the rain and pushed open the heavy wooden door of the Carnivore bar.
target: Lumian paulisper tacite murmuravit, deinde per imbrem cucurrit et gravem ianuam ligneam tabernae Carnivore aperuit.

source: Upon arriving in Morora, after almost reassembling the Abscessed Hand’s body, he had started referring to it as Hand Bro, half-jokingly and half to show “closeness,” hoping it wouldn’t attack him when fully restored, as there might be other dangers then.
target: Adveniens in Morora, postquam paene corpus Manūs Abscessae refecisset, coepit id Hand Bro appellare, dimidio iocose et dimidio propinquitatem ostendere, sperans ne eum oppugneret cum plene restitutum esset, cum aliae pericula existimabantur.

source: Just as he entered the bar, bringing in the rain, Lumian saw a familiar figure.
target: Simul ac in tabernam intravit, imbrem inferens, Lumian figuram familiaris vidit.

source: That figure sat on a high stool in front of the bar, their hair tinged with red, eyebrows and eyes leaning towards brown, looking handsome yet unlikable due to their overly sharp features.
target: Illa figura in alto scabello ante tabernam sedebat, capillis rubro tinctis, supercilia atque oculi castanei, speciosa sed non amabilis propter nimia acuta lineamenta.

source: Albus!
target: Albus!

source: Albus Medici!
target: Albus Medici!

source: Lumian tensed, though his expression remained calm as he smiled and walked towards the bar.
target: Lumian contraxit, quamquam vultus eius placidus remansit, subridente et ad tabernam properans.

source: He used to think Albus Medici was mysterious and possibly involved in some consOriginal.
target: Olim putabat Albus Medici esse mysteriosum et fortasse in quibusdam fraudibus implicatum.

source: Later, he learned about the existence of the Red Angel Medici, realizing this former King of Angels had orchestrated a massive plot and successfully obtained the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the Hunter pathway from Vermonda Sauron in Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: Postea didicit de existentia Rubri Angeli Medici, intellegens hunc quondam Regem Angelorum magnam machinamentum extruxisse et feliciter proprietatem Beyonder Sequenciae I viae Venatoris a Vermonda Sauron in Aetate Quarta Trier adeptum esse.

source: This made Lumian associate Albus Medici with the Red Angel, suspecting Albus was the King of Angels’ agent, sent to Morora to find a way to get close to 0-01.
target: Hoc faciebat ut Lumian Albus Medici cum Rubro Angelo coniungeretur, suspicatus eum esse agentem Regis Angelorum, ad Mororam missum ut viam ad 0-01 appropinquare inveniret.

source: For Lumian, this was bad news, as Medici was close to ascending to the Red Priest’s divine throne!
target: Lumiano hoc mala nuntia videbantur, nam Medici prope ascendendum ad thronum divinum Sacerdotis Rubri erat!

source: Albus Medici noticed Lumian’s gaze and turned, looking back at Lumian, who had made no effort to disguise himself beyond restoring his hair color.
target: Albus Medici conspexit aspectum Luminiani et conversus est, revidens Luminianum, qui nihil nisi capillorum colorem restitutum se tegere conatus erat.

source: “What brings you here?” Lumian smiled as if meeting an old friend.
target: “Quid te hic adfert?” subridens Lumian dixit, quasi veteri amico conveniretur.

source: Albus returned the smile. “What brings you here?”
target: Albus similiter subridens respondit: “Quid te hic adfert?”

source: “Of course, I was captured,” Lumian laughed, sitting beside Albus and tapping the bar counter, “Give me a steak, tenderloin, medium-rare,” he told the bartender, who looked as if he had lost his parents.
target: “Scilicet, captus sum,” risit Lumian, sedens iuxta Albam et pulsans mensam tabernae, “Da mihi steak, lumbum tenerum, medium coctum,” inquit ad cauponem, qui videbatur quasi parentes suos amisisset.

source: “Are you mimicking me? Also being randomly captured and ordering a tenderloin steak,” Albus said, one foot on the stool’s footrest, the other resting on his knee.
target: “Imitasne me? Etiam captus fortuito esse et lumbum tenerum iubere?” inquit Albus, cum unus pes in subsellii sustentaculo positus esset, alterum in genu reposito.

source: Before Lumian could respond, he relaxed and asked with a smile, “What crime did you commit?”
target: Antequam Lumian responderet, se relaxavit et subridente quaesivit: “Quod crimine commisisti?”

source: “Murder, blasphemy, arson, causing explosions, kidnapping…” Lumian repeated the crimes he had told Guei and others before, but not in the same order.
target: “Homicidium, blasphemia, incendium, explosionum causatio, rapina…” repetebat Lumian scelera quae Guei et aliis antea enuntiaverat, sed non ordine eodem.

source: He was relaxed as he asked, “What about you?”
target: Relaxatus quaesivit: “Et tu?”

source: “Me?” Albus jiggled his foot resting on his knee, “Murder, arson, inciting riots, attempting to overthrow the government.”
target: “Ego?” inquit Albus, pedem in suo genu quassans, “Homicidium, incendium, seditionem incitandi, conatus ad regimen evertere.”

source: “Which government?” Lumian asked in a tone of old friends reuniting.
target: “Quod regimen?” inquit Lumian, in tono veterorum amicorum conveniendorum.

source: “Intis.” Albus shrugged, “Don’t ask me why I tried to overthrow the Intis government and ended up in this strange city in Lenburg. I don’t know either.”
target: “Intis.” Albus umeros levavit et dixit: “Noli me interrogare cur conatus sim regimen Intis evertere et in hac urbe mirabili Lenburg incidere; neque ego scio.”

source: That’s such a patronizing answer… Lumian nodded in agreement. “Yeah, I didn’t commit crimes in Lenburg either.”
target: Ista responsio ita superba est… Lumian annuit consentiens: “Ita, et ego in Lenburg scelera non commissus sum.”

source: As the two former Iron and Blood Cross Order members “chatted,” two steaks were served.
target: Dum duo pristini membri Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis confabulabant, duo steak serviebantur.

source: Looking at the steaks on white porcelain plates, slightly bloody and with a good-looking texture, Lumian remained silent and didn’t pick up his knife and fork.
target: Intuens steaks in patinis albis ex porcelane, leviter sanguineos et pulchrae structurae, Lumian silentium servavit et culter atque furcam non levavit.

source: He sensed a connection.
target: Coniunctionem sensit.

source: This was indeed the Abscessed Hand’s rotten flesh, cut from the body!
target: Hoc re vera erat caro putrida Manūs Abscessae, ex corpore secta!

source: After a few seconds, Lumian glanced to the side and found Albus Medici also staring at the “steak” without moving.
target: Post paucos segundos, Lumian ad latus intuefactus est et invenit Album Medici quoque “steak” immobile spectantem.

source: Lumian smiled and asked, “Why aren’t you eating?”
target: Lumian subridens rogavit: “Cur non edis?”

source: Albus responded with a radiant smile. “Why aren’t you?”
target: Albus respondit, radianti subridente: “Cur non edis?”
